headline: Late-night major news: home-purchase threshold lowered inside Beijing's Fifth Ring Road, property market gets another policy boost
summary: Beijing lowered the home-purchase threshold inside the Fifth Ring Road, adding another policy support for the property market. The measure also covers loan amounts and provident fund loans.
why: Property policy in China shapes demand for housing, which affects developers, banks and the wider construction and household sectors.
